item.description:
New • When Claude Code or Codex is having an outage, Actvt says so. A line on the limits card and in the menu names the incident and links to it, and the "errors are piling up" alert tells you when the problem is on the provider's side, then again when it's over. It reads Anthropic's and OpenAI's public status pages, with no account and nothing about you sent. Turn it off in Settings > Agents
Improved • Privacy detection now catches eight more kinds of secret pasted into a prompt: Slack and Discord webhook URLs, Google OAuth tokens, and PyPI, SendGrid, Twilio, Telegram bot and 1Password service-account tokens. Your existing sessions are checked again once, in the background, after the update

Fixed • Presentable Mode now hides your MCP server and Skill names in the Overview. In "Where it went", servers and Skills read "Server 1" and "Skill 1", and so do servers you set up but never called. MCP tools in Tool usage carry the same masked server name. Sizes, shares and call counts stay as they are

New • The session browser totals what you filtered: a line under the filters shows how many sessions match, what they cost together, their tokens and active time, and how many have no price yet. Select it to copy it. Presentable Mode hides the dollars • Filter sessions by git branch
Improved • Codex sessions now show their git branch, which Codex records whenever it runs in a repository. The first launch re-reads your sessions once to fill it in for older ones
Fixed • A new Claude Code session that stops at a permission prompt in its first seconds now gets its "waiting" alert. Before, it could stay silent if Actvt hadn't looked at the session yet
